handoff_instructions: M3-T01 implemented. New file packages/core/src/services/employee-identity.ts: resolveEmployeeByPhone(ctx, rawPhone) uses normalizeToE164 (M3-T00) to match an inbound number against active employees.phone within ctx.organizationId. Exactly one match -> {status:'matched', employee}. Unparseable number or zero matches -> creates a 'missing_data' ops case, returns {status:'unknown', opsCase}. More than one active employee sharing a number -> creates a 'low_confidence' ops case, returns {status:'ambiguous', candidates, opsCase}. Requires employee.read authorization; reuses createOpsCase (already audited+evented) for the ops-case path. Exported from packages/core/src/index.ts (one-line addition). New tests in packages/core/test/employee-identity.test.ts cover: match regardless of formatting, tenant isolation (same number in org B never matches), unparseable input, no active match, a deactivated employee's number treated as unknown (not matched), and ambiguous with two active employees sharing a line. pnpm lint/typecheck/test all pass (core: 164 passed | 7 skipped). No new tables/migrations in this step, so no RLS changes needed. Next: M3-T02 'Migration: equipment registry'.
